info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Servicing Activity Insight API
info.description: The Servicing Activity Insight API provides detailed analysis of servicing activities across multiple channels in the banking domain. This API allows users to retrieve insightful data about customer interactions, service efficiency, and channel performance. Typical consumers include business analysts and operations teams looking to optimize service delivery and enhance customer experience. By analyzing the data returned from this API, organizations can make informed decisions to improve overall servicing strategies.

get.summary: Fetches the servicing activity analysis for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint retrieves detailed servicing activity analysis data for the specified resource ID. It provides insights into the servicing patterns and trends relevant to the resource, allowing users to make informed decisions based on the analysis results.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve servicing activity analysis data for the specified resource. It includes parameters that allow for detailed filtering and customization of the data returned.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the servicing activity analysis data.
